{{Quote|When in trouble, Gungans go to sacred place.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="TPM" />}}
The '''Gungan Sacred Place''' was the name of a sacred monument on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was located north of the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]], on the foothills of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

==History==
The Gungan Sacred Place was built by the [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|Elders]]. It was considered sacred by the Gungans, however, its exact religious or practical significance is unknown.

It was here where [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] fled after the [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|assault]] on [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on her return to Naboo with her escort, was guided there by the Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Battle of the Sacred Place|formed the first alliance]] and peace treaty between the Gungans and the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" />

There, they planned the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]: while the Gungans would [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|divert]] the Federation forces by amassing the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]], Amidala, together with her two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escorts, would attempt to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|liberate]] the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gungan_sacred_place_concept.png|thumb|250px|Conceptual art for the Gungan sacred place drawn by [[Doug Chiang]]]]
The scenes set in the sacred place in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] were filmed in [[Whippendell Woods]]. The sacred place was the site of a mission in the Gungan campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The campaign was also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. The scene also appeared in LEGO form during a cutscene in the [[2005]]'s ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation]].

The [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' incorrectly places the Gungan Sacred Place in the [[Lasay Swamp]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
